import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc

STATES = ["A", "B", "C"]
campaign = {
  "types": [
    {"name": "St", "kind": "enum", "values": STATES},
    {"name": "Msg", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
    {"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}
  ],
  "modules": [
    {"name": "job", "params": [["state", "St"], ["msg", "Msg"], ["n", "N8"]],
     "result": ["o", "B"], "requires": ["lt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N8", 10]]},
    {"name": "gate", "params": [["q", "N8"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
     "requires": ["gt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "N8", 4]]}
  ],
  "calls": [],
  "pipes": [{"target": "job", "filter": "gate", "bind": {"q": "n"}}],
  "entries": ["job"],
  "machine": {"states": STATES, "initial": "A", "state_param": "state",
              "message_param": "msg",
              "transitions": [{"from": "A", "to": "B", "command": "go", "cost": 1,
                               "when": ["gt", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N8", 2]]}]},
  "runs": []
}
# layout: state x0(4), msg buffer x1, msg chars x2,x3, n x4, o x5, flag x6
def run(state, msg, n, o, flag):
    padded = msg + '\x00' * (2 - len(msg))
    objs = [("x0", enc(STATES.index(state), 4))]
    objs += [("x%d" % (2 + i), enc(ord(c), 1)) for i, c in enumerate(padded)]
    objs += [("x4", enc(n, 1)), ("x5", enc(o, 1)), ("x6", enc(flag, 1))]
    return {"entry": "job", "ktest": ktest(objs)}
runs = [
    run("A", "m", 1, 1, 0),    # accepted=(n>4)=False, flag must be 1 -> 0 given -> INVALID (flag precedes filter/reachability)
    run("A", "m", 1, 1, 1),    # attestation ok -> requires n<10 ok -> accepted False -> FILTERED (filter precedes reachability)
    run("C", "m", 9, 1, 0),    # accepted=(9>4)=True, flag 0 ok, requires ok, state C unreachable -> UNREACHABLE
    run("B", "m", 9, 1, 0),    # usable, guard n>2 ok -> READY cost 1 commands [go, m]
    run("B", "m", 1, 1, 1),    # accepted False, flag 1 ok -> FILTERED
    run("B", "m", 9, 1, 0),    # duplicate of case 0
    run("B", "m", 3, 1, 1),    # accepted=(3>4)=False, flag 1 ok -> FILTERED (guard would fail too)
]
campaign["runs"] = runs
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
PYEOF
